name: Gmail
description: Watches your Gmail inbox and lets Hive tell you when an email actually needs you. Read-only IMAP with a Google app password: nothing is sent, deleted or marked as read.

settings.label: App password
settings.help: Create one at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords (needs 2-Step Verification). Not your normal Google password.

settings.label: Skip the Promotions, Social and Forums tabs
Only messages Gmail marks as Important

docs:
1. Turn on 2-Step Verification for your Google account: https://myaccount.google.com/signinoptions/two-step-verification
2. Create an app password at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords (name it "Hive"). Google shows 16 letters.
3. Paste your Gmail address and the app password below, then Save.
4. Enable the plugin and press "Test connection".

Hive only reads mail: it never sends, deletes or marks anything as read. Only messages that arrive after you turn it on are checked. Revoke the app password any time to cut access.
